生成された動画：=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided Riven reference for visual continuity.

Use the provided Riven's Broken Sword reference for the weapon.

Use the provided Burning Settlement reference
for the exterior environment.

Use the provided Trapped Elderly Man reference
for the elderly civilian and the damaged burning building.

Riven is in her Two Years Later appearance.

She carries only the HANDLE-SIDE REMAINING HALF
of her Broken Sword.

The missing upper half is completely gone.

The Broken Sword remains dormant.

No rune glow.
No magical energy.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Natural human movement.

Burning wooden building and settlement at nightfall.

Orange firelight.

Heavy but natural smoke.

Natural fire, wood cracking, breathing,
footsteps, and environmental sound.

Restrained realistic acting.

Natural English dialogue and lip sync.

No subtitles.

No background music.

No combat.

Keep the rescue simple and physically readable.

Use only TWO major cinematic shots.


=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Riven has reached the elderly man
trapped inside the burning building.

She immediately helps free him.

She tells him:

"Come on."

Riven supports the elderly man
and helps him out of the building.

Outside, she brings him to a safer position.

The elderly man thanks her.

Riven then looks back toward the village road
where the mysterious figure had been standing.

The figure is gone.

Only the empty burning road remains.

CUT.


=== SHOT 1 — GET HIM OUT ===

OPEN directly inside the damaged building.

Do not begin with an exterior establishing shot.

Riven is already beside the trapped elderly man.

Continue naturally from the previous moment.

Orange firelight enters through
the damaged wooden structure.

Smoke moves through the interior.

The elderly man is trapped
behind fallen wooden debris.

Keep the obstruction simple.

Do not create a complicated collapse.


Riven quickly understands the situation.

She lowers the Broken Sword
and places it safely on the ground nearby
so both of her hands are free.

The sword remains clearly visible.

It is still only the broken handle-side half.

Do not restore the missing blade.


Riven immediately moves toward the debris.

She grips the heavy fallen wooden beam
blocking the elderly man's escape.

With a strong controlled effort,
Riven lifts and shifts the beam
far enough to clear his path.

Keep the movement grounded and physical.

Do not turn this into a dramatic strength showcase.


The elderly man is now free.

Riven reaches toward him and says firmly:

"Come on."


She helps him stand.

The elderly man is weak
and unsteady on his feet.

Riven supports him with one arm.


Before leaving,
Riven quickly retrieves her Broken Sword.

Keep the weapon lowered.

She does not use it for combat.


Riven supports the elderly man
and guides him toward the exit.

They move together out of the burning building.

Wood creaks around them.

Small pieces of ash and dust fall naturally.

Do not create a large explosion.

Do not interrupt the rescue with combat.


=== SHOT 2 — THE EMPTY ROAD ===

Continue outside the building.

Riven helps the elderly man
move away from the burning structure.

They reach a relatively clear area
beside the village road.

Riven carefully helps him settle
against a low wooden fence,
wall,
or other stable support.


The elderly man catches his breath.

He looks at Riven.

Quietly and sincerely, he says:

"Thank you."


Riven looks at him briefly.

She does not answer.

Keep her reaction restrained.


Then something draws her attention.

Riven slowly turns her head
toward the main village road.


Camera follows her gaze.


Show the same direction
where the mysterious dark figure
had previously been standing.


But now—

THE ROAD IS EMPTY.


The mysterious figure is gone.


Do not show it disappearing.

Do not show it hiding somewhere else.

Do not reveal another silhouette.


There is only:

the empty road,

burning buildings,

moving smoke,

floating ash,

and orange firelight.


Hold briefly on the empty road.


CUT back to Riven.

She quietly watches the place
where the figure had been.


No dialogue.

No dramatic reaction.

No power-up.

No combat.


Hold for a brief moment.


CUT.


=== END STATE ===

The elderly man has been rescued.

He is outside the burning building
and temporarily safe.

Riven still carries the same dormant Broken Sword.

The mysterious dark figure
is no longer on the village road.

Riven sees that it is gone.

CUT.、16:9
